summary: Read all 18 owned units s0002–s0019 in Chinese. No birth or age is stated anywhere in them. The only deaths are Hui (s0009, dated AD 333 through Jinshu 108), Qidegui (s0010, 奔死於外) and Zhao (s0014, 皝殺昭), and all three are captured. Era conversions are correct: Jianwu 317, Taining-end 325–326, Xianhe 9 = 334, each at year level with no Julian/Gregorian issue. The post-Hui sequence correctly uses a 333–334 event window. The repaired s0006 and mother attestations are correctly undated. There are two defects. claim-66 gives an exact AD 317 to repeated campaigns (累有功). hints-p004 lists discrete 333 and 334 values, but its owner has only window events. 68 of 70 items are supported.
